notes.summary: Placeholder vocabulary for Insurance Pillar v0.1. Policy types, coverage scopes, claim categories, and term lengths are illustrative descriptive tags. Real deployments must substitute insurer/jurisdiction-specific terms and policy-document references before any canon_root is anchored for public use. Nothing here constitutes a coverage guarantee, rate, exclusion, or binding policy term.

attestation_types.policy_issuance: records issuance of a policy with effective dates
attestation_types.claim_submission: records submission of a claim under a policy
attestation_types.claim_settlement: records final settlement of a submitted claim
attestation_types.coverage_proof: confirms active coverage for a given resident / scope
attestation_types.bond_guarantee: records a surety / bond backing a resident obligation
